summary: Iteration 2 re-test on Bakers app. Both previous blockers are FIXED. Backend: all 13 pytest cases pass, including POST /api/chat (Claude Sonnet 5 responds with a valid ~200-word French baking answer) and GET /api/chat/history. Frontend E2E: after login the Redirect guard in app/auth.tsx correctly navigates to /(tabs). Verified: hero-recipe + tips carousel + classics carousel on Accueil; chip-Tous/Pains/Viennoiseries/Pâtisseries filter the recipe grid; recipe/[id] shows back-btn, fav-btn, segment-ingredients, segment-steps and ing-* items; Assistant chat-input + chat-send trigger Claude Sonnet 5 and the reply renders on screen; share form (title/time/ingredients/steps/description/publish) publishes and appears in Profile > Mes recettes; tab-mine, tab-favs and logout-btn work (logout returns to /auth). Minor issues: (1) segmented tab testIDs are `segment-ingredients` / `segment-steps` (spec called them `seg-*`); (2) bottom-nav tabs have no testID (only visible French text); (3) chat message bubbles have no `msg-*` testIDs; (4) share form has required `description` and hydration/category selectors that were not called out in the review spec.

minor.issue: Unused `user: Optional[dict] = None` in signature (cosmetic; still there).

issues: Chat message bubbles render text correctly but do not have per-message testIDs (e.g. msg-user, msg-assistant), which makes automated assertions of the AI reply harder.
Bottom-nav Tabs (Accueil/Recettes/Assistant/Profil) do not expose testIDs like tab-home/tab-recipes/tab-assistant/tab-profile. Automation must fall back to text or route navigation.
Segmented tabs use testIDs `segment-ingredients` and `segment-steps` (the review spec expected `seg-ingredients` / `seg-preparation`). Functionality works; naming inconsistent with spec.

action_items: OPTIONAL (frontend, low priority): add testIDs to bottom Tab bar screens (`tab-home`, `tab-recipes`, `tab-assistant`, `tab-profile`) via `tabBarButtonTestID` or a wrapping Pressable, to ease E2E.
OPTIONAL: rename segmented tab testIDs on recipe/[id] to match the spec (`seg-ingredients`, `seg-preparation`) or update the spec.
OPTIONAL: add per-message testIDs in Assistant (e.g. `msg-<index>-<role>`) to allow asserting AI reply text.
OPTIONAL cleanup: remove unused `user` param from `list_recipes` in backend/server.py.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_recipes still has an unused Optional user param (cosmetic).
share.tsx `submit` requires title+description+ingredients+steps+time — the review spec listed only 4 fields; description is mandatory (works, but doc mismatch).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows verified (auth redirect, home, recipes filter, recipe detail + fav, assistant AI chat, share publish, profile mine/favs, logout)

rca_of_issue: Iteration 1 blockers verified fixed: (a) app/auth.tsx now has `if (user) return <Redirect href='/(tabs)'/>` (line 38) so successful login/register triggers navigation on the next render; (b) EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget recharged — POST /api/chat now returns a valid 200 with a French Claude Sonnet 5 answer (~200 words including Fermentation/Façonnage/Cuisson advice).
